desc:
⛏️ Build the BIGGEST quarry empire on Roblox! 💰💸🤑

Start with a pickaxe and a patch of dirt… end up with giant excavators, dump trucks and a full ore processing plant! 🚜🏗️🪨

Use codes WELCOME and 1KLIKES for free upgrades & cash!

💎 HOW TO PLAY
⛏️ Mine ore by hand to earn your first cash
🚧 Buy machines that mine FOR YOU – even while you're offline!
⬆️ Upgrade your workers to mine faster and earn more
🏭 Unlock the Processing Plant, Storage Bays and more
🔁 Rebirth to earn 2x MORE cash every time!

❓ Did you know... You continue to earn 100% of your income offline! 💰

✨ FEATURES
💎 Discover rare ores and complete your Ore Index
🎁 Daily rewards, timed rewards and offline earnings
👥 Play with friends – your workers look like your friends!

👍 LIKE the game and ⭐ FAVORITE!
🔔 Join the group for a FREE bonus reward!
